title: TabType wire vocabulary contract
description: Keys are proto enum value names; the generator cross-checks them against the TabType enum from `buf build` (every value exactly once, including UNSPECIFIED, whose token is the empty string the CLI treats as "no --type given"). `wireToken` is what the CLI accepts and emits and what the browser writes to data-tab-type. The proto-canonical spelling (TAB_TYPE_FILE) is always accepted on parse, so a token pasted back from JSON round-trips without listing it here.
